text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Trainer. To think I'd be 
late...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"We were holding a review session. About 
my recent races."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
A breakdown in form reflects a disturbed 
mind. I must focus my spirit even more...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It is utterly disgraceful... I must 
reflect further upon my actions, including 
being late today.

I cautioned Believe to take it easy, as 
she had a tendency to lose track of time 
while self-reflecting.
